jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer - UAS
jobs.description:
As COLSA continues to expand our uncrewed aerial systems (UAS) capabilities, we’re seeking an experienced **Embedded Software Engineer** to join our growing team in **Madison, Alabama.** You’ll design, develop, test, and integrate software for sUAS systems and sensors, supporting the full development lifecycle from initial design through integration, flight testing, and deployment.


*Principal Duties and Responsibilities (\*Essential Functions)*


* Designs, develops, tests, integrates, and troubleshoots software for sUAS systems and sensors.\*
* Develops and applies advanced software engineering methods and techniques to solve complex technical problems.\*
* Supports software development throughout the lifecycle, including design, implementation, integration, testing, and deployment.\*
* Performs systems modeling, simulation, analysis, and complex software testing.\*
* Works closely with hardware engineers on characteristics and considerations that affect software systems.\*
* Plans and technically leads projects or major phases of projects, coordinating with engineers and technical support staff as needed.\*
* Reviews current technologies and engineering practices relevant to assigned projects.
* Reviews technical products and supports implementation and documentation of new or existing software.
* Provides technical consultation and may evaluate vendor products, services, or capabilities as needed.


*At COLSA, people are our most valuable resource and centered at our core value. We invite you to unite your talents with opportunity and be a part of our “Family of Professionals!” Learn about our employee\-centric culture and benefits here:* *https://www.colsa.com/culture\_benefits*

  

  

Required Experience  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 8 years of related experience.
* Experience developing software for sUAS/UAV, autonomous aircraft, or other robotic platforms.
* Experience with Linux\-based embedded platforms and technologies such as ARM processors, microcontrollers, or single\-board computers.
* Knowledge of UAS electrical systems, payload integration, sensor integration, or avionics.
* Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, ROS/ROS 2, or comparable autonomy frameworks.
* Experience supporting the full system development lifecycle, from initial requirements and design through implementation, integration, flight testing, and deployment.
* Willing and able to obtain an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate if required for the position.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must be able to complete a criminal background check and/or obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, if required for the position.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Familiarity with aerospace/defense development processes, configuration management, and formal verification and validation.
* FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate.


Applicant selected may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. COLSA Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer, Data Center, Colocation Regional Engineering - AMER
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Application deadline: Sep 30, 2026  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you an engineer with a passion for data center design and looking for a challenge to chart your own course? If so, we are looking for you to help us make history.  

  

AWS data centers are the foundation upon which our software and services operates to meet the growing demands of our customers. This role provides the opportunity to collaborate with business development, design engineers, data center operations professionals, external vendors and consultants, and other cross\-functional teams to assess and select colocation facilities that meet our business requirements.  

  

You will be able to showcase your in\-depth understanding of data center design, engineering, and operations of infrastructure common to data centers, telecommunications facilities and other critical environment infrastructure.  

  

You will work directly with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability.  

  

You will have opportunities to influence standards for data center products, build and improve processes, and to guide the direction of our colocation data center portfolio on a global scale. So, if you are a strong leader with solid data center mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural (MEPS) infrastructure design engineering experience, Amazon will present a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment that is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional rewarding opportunity for you.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers and telecommunications facilities within the region.
* Reviews vendor critical infrastructure designs and perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit\-for\-use/fit\-for\-service for AWS cloud compute and networking services.
* Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad\-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design\-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
* Lead, Review, and approve designs for existing co\-location (colo) data center upgrades which improve availability/efficiency.
* Interface with internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering site audits within Amazon’s owned or colo data centers.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  

A day in the life  

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.  

  

Colo Regional Engineers:  

* Possess strong engineering judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty.
* Are detail and data oriented.
* Manage engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders.
* Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

  

About the team  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and othe

jobs.title: Tech Lead - Hardware /Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 10/17/2026
  
  

Meet the Team
  
  

The Outshift by Cisco team is one of Cisco’s most visible innovation organizations, driving the next generation of transformative technologies and business opportunities. As part of the Strategy, Incubation\& Applications group led by Cisco’s Chief Strategy Officer, you will collaborate with some of the company’s most forward\-thinking researchers, engineers, and technology leaders. Within the Outshift Quantum Research team and Quantum Labs, we are pioneering the design and development of practical, scalable, and efficient quantum networking technologies — foundational building blocks for the future Quantum Internet. Our multidisciplinary team of scientists and engineers is dedicated to advancing the state of the art in quantum networking, distributed quantum systems, and quantum\-enabled applications.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

Cisco Quantum Research is seeking a highly skilled Embedded\& Controls Engineer to help develop the next generation of deployable quantum networking hardware.
  
  

You will take end\-to\-end ownership of the electronics and control architecture that connects our advanced photonic and quantum hardware to Cisco's software and orchestration platforms. Your work will span custom PCB design, mixed\-signal and high\-speed electronics, FPGA and embedded systems, firmware, precision control algorithms, hardware APIs, and rack\-level system integration.
  
  

Working closely with our photonics, software, systems, and mechanical engineering teams, you will transform laboratory prototypes into robust, manufacturable systems capable of operating outside the laboratory. You will address challenging requirements including ultra\-low\-noise electronics, precise synchronization, sub\-nanosecond timing, high\-speed signal integrity, closed\-loop optical control, and reliable remote management.
  
  

Your work will establish the electronic and control infrastructure required to bring Cisco's quantum networking technologies from research prototypes into scalable, field\-deployable platforms.
  
  

**You Will:**  

* Architect custom mixed\-signal PCBs for precision control, data acquisition, timing, and communication within rack\-mounted quantum systems.
* Develop embedded software and firmware to control custom electronics, optical components, and photonic devices.
* Design high\-speed analog and digital signal paths while maintaining stringent requirements for signal integrity, latency, synchronization, and noise.
* Interface with embedded processors, FPGAs, ADCs, DACs, and discrete control and telemetry signals.
* Design, implement, and tune digital control loops for precision regulation and stabilization of optical and electronic hardware.
* Architect low\-noise power distribution, grounding, and control electronics for sensitive quantum hardware.
* Develop interfaces for system communication using technologies such as Ethernet, UART, SPI, USB, GPIO, and high\-speed data\-converter interfaces.
* Define and implement APIs that enable higher\-level software platforms to control hardware and access system status and telemetry.
* Develop custom cable harnessing and interconnect solutions for RF, digital, analog, telemetry, and high\-speed signals.
* Collaborate with software, systems, mechanical, optical, and photonics engineers to optimize thermal performance, grounding, EMI/EMC, signal integrity, and overall system reliability.
* Lead hardware bring\-up and debug complex interactions between electronics, firmware, FPGA logic, and system\-level software.
* Create and implement comprehensive hardware, firmware, and system\-level test plans; analyze results and drive design improvements.
* Transform laboratory and benchtop prototypes into reliable, manufacturable, field\-deployable rack\-mounted systems.


Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors \+ 8 years of related experience, or Masters \+ 6 years of related experience, or PhD \+ 3 years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience.
* 3\+ years of experience developing custom electronic hardware and embedded control systems.
* Experience designing mixed\-signal PCBs incorporating embedded processors, microcontrollers, or FPGAs.
* Experience in embedded software/firmware development using C/C\+\+.
* Experience with FPGA\-based systems, including familiarity with RTL and/or High\-Level Synthesis (HLS).


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience developing electronics and control systems for lasers, electro\-optic modulators, optical switches, photonic integrated circuits, or other photonic devices.
* Experience with analog and digital electronics, signal integrity, impedance matching, grounding, and high\-speed PCB design
* Experience working with ADCs, DACs, and mixed\-signal data\-acquisition and control systems.
* Experience with common communication interfaces including Ethernet, UART, SPI, USB, and GPIO.
* Experience designing low\-noise power distribution and electronics for sensitive instrumentation.
* Background in classical optics, quantum optics, quantum networking, photonics, or precision instrumentation.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Research Tools
jobs.description:
Engineering · Full\-time · San Francisco

  

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

### **About the role**


As a Software Engineer on the RL Data team, you’ll design and build the tools that researchers and external contributors use to create, review, submit, and monitor the environments and tasks behind Cursor’s reinforcement\-learning runs. This is a full\-stack product\-engineering role embedded in a research team.


You’ll own the review and acceptance experience end to end: from rollout and transcript inspection, task\-quality signals grader and reward\-hacking analysis, to the workflows that move a submission into training. From there, you’ll build authoring interfaces that let researchers, vendors, and domain experts create and improve environments and tasks quickly and confidently.


Your work will significantly shorten the loop from a task idea or data sources, to candidate task, to trusted training data.

### **What you’ll work on**

* Create fast, trustworthy workflows for vendors and research team to interact effectively with each other — vendor task creation and iteration, vendor submissions, and task acceptance into training.
* Build review tools for inspecting and comparing rollouts, transcripts, grader outputs, and other signals of task quality.
* Develop environment\-health, failure\-search, versioning, and catalog experiences that make training data easy to understand, manage, and extend.
* Establish a shared component kit, then use it to build self\-serve interfaces for creating and improving tasks with quality checks inline.

### **You may be a fit if**

* You’ve shipped full\-stack products and owned systems from user interface through storage or services, using technologies such as TypeScript and React alongside Node, Python, or Go.
* You’ve built dense, data\-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards—and you have strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered.
* You’ve built or maintained a design system or component library and can establish durable product and engineering conventions for a fast\-moving team.
* You’ve designed review, QA, moderation, fraud, or acceptance workflows where users had an incentive to get past the checks, and you know how to keep those systems honest.
* You care about data quality, and are willing to inspect raw data. Experience with evaluations, graders, reinforcement learning, or data\-quality systems is helpful but not required.
* You move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open\-ended problems from rough need to reliable product.

### **ing**


If there appears to be a fit, we’ll schedule two or three short technical interviews focused on frontend craft for dense data and system design for a review\-and\-acceptance workflow. After that, we’ll invite you onsite to work on a small project using real rollouts, discuss ideas, and meet the team.


\#LI\-DNI

jobs.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Summary:**

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti\-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.  

  

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Firmware Engineer to join our innovative team at Viavi Solutions Inc. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and testing of embedded firmware for our cutting\-edge network test and measurement solutions. You will play a key role in bringing new products to market and enhancing existing ones, working within a dynamic and collaborative environment.  

  

Job Responsibilities

  

* Analyzes, designs, programs, debugs and modifies software.
* Troubleshoots code for firmware (IC embedded code) applications.
* Work often involves analog and digital hardware and software operating systems.
* Position requires knowledge and exposure to hardware design. Typically programs in machine language, assembly language and high\-level languages (e.g., C, C\+\+).

jobs.title: Senior Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------



Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in\-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W\-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in\-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C\-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**



From life\-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.



Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.



Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.



Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in\-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------



The **Senior Flight Software Engineer** is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves and operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. The team is responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Develop reliable flight software that determine how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate throughout the entire mission.
* Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C\+\+.
* Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.
* Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open\-ended problems.
* Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V\&V) technique.
* Teamwork, communicate and problem solve in a collaborative environment.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.
* 5\+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.
* Experience with development in C\+\+, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------


* End\-to\-end experience building and launching a spacecraft.
* Experience developing and testing real\-time embedded systems.
* Experience with safety\-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.
* Experience with CCSDS telemetry and telecommand system.
* Experience with F' or cFS framework.
* Experience with Python, or Rust.
* Knowledge of basic analog and digital electronics.
* Familiarity with SPI, I2C, CAN, EtherCAT.

**Pay Range**
-------------


* Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 \- $216,031/ per year.
* This role is on\-sitein El Segundo, CA.
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job\-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long\-term cash awards.

**Benefits**
------------


**Consider your benefits covered for launch.** At Varda, we invest in benefits and perks that support your health, financial well\-being, and life beyond work. Benefits vary by position, with packages designed specifically for our regular full\-time employees and interns.

  

**Regular Full\-Time Positions:**


**Health \& Wellness**


* Flexible PTO policy \+ 12 paid holidays
* 100% company\-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for employees and dependents with FSA and employer\-matched HSA options
* Voluntary accident, hospital, critical illness, and pet insurance
* $120/month wellness reimbursement for gym and fitness expenses
* 12 weeks of parental leave (with supplemental disability leave for CA mothers)
* Family building, pregnancy, parenting and menopause benefits via Maven Clinic
* Sponsored One Medical memberships for employees and their dependents

  


**Financial \& Retirement**


* Substantial incentive equity in a fully funded space start\-up
* 401(k) retirement plan with 6% employer match (immediately vested)
* $20/pay period cell phone reimbursement
* Relocation support for new hires, if needed

  


**Workplace Experience \& Perks**


* Fully stocked kitchen with lunch provided daily and dinner provided twice weekly
* Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and mission\-success celebrations
* Complimentary EV charging

  


**Benefits for Internship Positions:**

  

**Health \& Wellness**


* Paid observed holidays.
* 100% company\-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for employees and dependents with FSA and employer\-matched HSA options.
* $120/month wellness reimbursement for gym and fitness expenses.
* Sponsored One Medical memberships for employees and their dependents.

  


**Financial**


* $20/pay period cell phone reimbursement.
* Up to $4,000 gross up in relocation support, if eligible
* Up to $850 commute credit through Lyft or car rental reimbursement, if eligible.

  


**Workplace Experience \& Perks**


* Fully stocked kitchen with lunch provided daily and dinner provided twice weekly
* Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and mission\-success celebr

jobs.title: Broadcast Systems Engineer, Prime Video Live Sports
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Prime Video is seeking an experienced Broadcast Systems Engineer for our Live Sports Production Technical Operations team. This role spans the design, integration, and day\-to\-day operation of broadcast production systems and the underlying compute and virtualization infrastructure that powers them. You will support infrastructure powering live events across our expanding sports portfolio including NFL, NBA, WNBA, NHL, NWSL, and NASCAR as well as the build\-out of new broadcast facilities on our Culver City campus.  

  

You will be part of the core engineering team responsible for designing, building, and maintaining a state\-of\-the\-art broadcast campus — working alongside network engineers, broadcast technicians, and architects to deploy and operate the compute and virtualization infrastructure that powers live sports at scale.  

  

As part of the Prime Video team, you will work on projects that are fast\-paced, technically varied, and high\-impact, with room to experiment with new technology, take creative risks, and collaborate with exceptional people.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Work as part of a core engineering team responsible for deploying and integrating production systems — collaborating closely with network and broadcast engineers, vendors, and production staff to bring new infrastructure and systems online.
* Manage the full lifecycle of server infrastructure: procurement support, automated provisioning, configuration management, patching, and decommissioning — physical installation and rack/cabling work as needed.
* Administer Linux, Windows, and macOS systems at scale across production, engineering, and post\-production environments.
* Maintain a systematic patching program across the full fleet: OS updates, firmware, BIOS, IPMI, application software, and hypervisor components — including patch cadences, testing pipelines, and rollback procedures that account for a live production environment.
* Approach every repeatable task as an automation opportunity — building scripts, pipelines, and tooling that eliminate manual work, reduce human error, and scale operations as our fleet grows.
* Manage and maintain Proxmox VE hypervisor clusters; deploy, configure, and lifecycle\-manage remote machines supporting broadcast applications, media services, backend services, control systems, and engineering tools.
* Maintain and continuously improve a monitoring and alerting platform covering all infrastructure layers — compute, virtualization, storage, network, and broadcast systems — integrating telemetry via APIs, Syslog, SNMP with dashboards, threshold alerting, anomaly detection, and on\-call escalation paths.
* Manage and maintain records for all infrastructure assets, including physical servers, network hardware, remote machines, and associated IP address space.
* Provide on\-call technical support during live broadcast events; rapidly triage and resolve on\-air incidents across the full infrastructure stack.
* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including as\-built drawings, system designs, VM inventories, provisioning runbooks, and change records.
* Approach all system design and implementation with a security\-first mindset — collaborating with Amazon Security on architecture reviews, patching compliance, and vulnerability remediation.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Broadcast Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in broadcast systems engineering within live production or media infrastructure environments
* Linux, Windows and macOS system administration experience at scale

The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of our AI devices require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. You will be part of our efforts to architect, design and implement a clean slate compiler for this activity and will be part of a team that includes compiler, machine learning algorithms and software, firmware and ASIC experts. * Experience in designing intermediate representations and implementing compiler optimization passes
* Experience with hardware architectures such as GPUs, TPUs, or custom AI accelerators
* Experience in software development using C\+\+ for compiler and systems\-level programming
* Experience leading end\-to\-end technical design and delivery of compiler infrastructure initiatives across multiple teams

jobs.title: Senior Spacecraft Systems Engineer, Avionics
jobs.description:
**About Varda**
---------------



Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in\-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W\-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in\-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C\-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**



From life\-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.



Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.



Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.



Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in\-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------



The **Senior Systems Engineer, Avionics** oversees the design, integration, and testing of avionics systems for our Winnebago Spaceship. They ensure that all systems are ready for both launch and operational phases, requiring a deep understanding of avionics system design, manufacturing processes, and operational protocols. They closely collaborate with various engineering teams and navigate conflicting requirements to achieve seamless system integration. Their expertise will be crucial in ensuring the vehicle meets its mission objectives, from space manufacturing to hypersonic testing during reentry.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Collaborate with cross functional teams to define project scopes and initial requirements, guiding designs from concept to prototype and full\-scale production.
* Develop electrical architecture, system diagrams, and budgets to account for power, telemetry, channel count, size, and mass predictions used to communicate closing vehicle solutions to company level objectives.
* Analyze architecture for potential faults and risks, develop comprehensive mitigation plans, resolve uncertainties, and collaborate on Fault Detection Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) or operational workarounds when hardware solutions are unfeasible.
* Conduct comprehensive verification plans for avionics systems on flight and HITL hardware, ensuring readiness for launch and compliance with mission objectives for space and reentry operations.
* Participate in mission operations as an Avionics specialist or system operator, where they'll determine system health, suggest corrective actions to reentry commit criteria for operational success.
* Oversee the integration of the Winnebago avionics systems, acting as the primary point of contact for integrated systems investigations.
* Design, build, and operate the Hardware In The Loop (HITL) testbeds, simulating the spacecraft on the ground to ensure all systems are mission ready.
* Develop avionics ground infrastructure, support the design and integration of test racks and R\&D equipment used to power and communicate with the flight vehicles. Contribute to developing engineering best practices, focusing on increased test automation and efficiency.
* Draw from their experiences to help mentor and train new engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in system design, test planning, and validation.
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python.
* Technical Expertise: Experience with power supplies, modular DAQ systems, RTD and 4\-20mA devices, and general test equipment.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------


* Proven experience taking vehicle electrical systems from concept to operational production.
* Prior experience setting up HITL testbeds, managing configuration control, and conducting system level tests.
* Familiarity with Unix environments and the ability to use command line utilities.
* Experience developing test cases and test equipment to meet vehicle operating conditions.
* Strong project or program management skills.
* Relevant prior roles: Avionics Hardware, FPGA Engineer, Electronics Test Engineer, Electrical Systems Engineer

**Pay Range**
-------------


* Salary range: Senior: $140,333 \- $179,314/ per year.
* This role is on\-site in El Segundo, CA.
* Leveling and base salary is determined by job\-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
* You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long\-term cash awards

**Benefits**
------------


**Consider your benefits covered for launch.** At Varda, we invest in benefits and perks that support your health, financial well\-being, and life beyond work. Benefits vary by position, with packages designed specifically for our regular full\-time employees and interns.

  

**Regular Full\-Time Positions:**


**Health \& Wellness**


* Flexible PTO policy \+ 12 paid holidays
* 100% company\-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for employees and dependents with FSA and employer\-matched HSA options
* Voluntary accident, hospital, critical illness, and pet insurance
* $120/

* Electrical design and analysis with Mentor Graphics XPedition and HyperLynx SI, SPICE.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Application deadline: Sep 30, 2026  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

You will be able to showcase your in\-depth understanding of data center design, engineering, and operations of infrastructure common to data centers, telecommunications facilities and other critical environment infrastructure.  

  

You will work directly with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability.  

  

You will have opportunities to influence standards for data center products, build and improve processes, and to guide the direction of our colocation data center portfolio on a global scale. * Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
* Directly support operational issues with ad\-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
* Own the design for existing data center upgrades and design\-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
* Lead, Review, and approve designs for existing co\-location (colo) data center upgrades which improve availability/efficiency.
* Interface with internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
* Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
* Initiate and lead engineering site audits within Amazon’s owned or colo data centers.
* Act as resident engineer during new construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and turnover.

  

A day in the life  

Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally.  

  

Colo Regional Engineers:  

* Possess strong engineering judgement and are able to provide recommendations despite uncertainty.
* Are detail and data oriented.
* Manage engineering projects and consultants.
* Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders.
* Be inclined to get into the field to see things up close.

  

About the team  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. ### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you love high profile and challenging projects supporting the Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC), then Serco has a great opportunity for you!

  



As the Experienced Electrical Engineer working onsite NSWC PCD located in Panama City, Florida, you will be integrated within a diverse team of multi\-disciplined engineers, and technicians supporting unmanned systems. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors by discovering your new role supporting this critical mission.

  



**This position is contingent upon the ability to obtain/maintain a DoD Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) Security Clearance**

  



**In this role, you will:**


* Lead the design of mixed\-signal hardware systems including microcontrollers (Arduino, ATmega, PIC, ESP32, etc.), power management systems (AC – DC converters, Transformers, LDOs), and sensor interfaces.
* Create detailed schematics and perform complex, multi\-layer PCB layouts using industry\-standard EDA tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, KiCad, Siemens Xpedition).
* Ensure strict adherence to best practices for signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC compliance.
* Implement microprocessors into designs using C/C\+\+.
* Run test simulations using Spice software (LTspice, Pspice, or equivalent).
* Assemble, test, and perform initial bring\-up of hardware prototypes.
* Utilize lab equipment such as mixed\-signal oscilloscopes, electronic loads, and multimeters to verify system performance against specifications.
* Develop and execute comprehensive hardware test plans, thermal testing, and reliability testing.
* Troubleshoot hardware issues down to the component level.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including hardware design specifications, BOMs (Bill of Materials), schematics, and detailed instruction documentation for end users.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**


* Active Interim Secret Clearance with ability to obtain/maintain TS/SCI clearance.
* US Citizenship.
* Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a strictly related discipline.
* 5 years of similar/related experience.
	+ Masters Degree will be considered in lieu of 2 years of experience.
* 3 years of experience in embedded hardware design and full product lifecycle development.
* Extensive experience in schematic capture and PCB layout tools (Altium Designer, Siemens Xpedition, or equivalent).
* Strong fundamental knowledge of both digital and analog circuit design.
* Experience with common embedded communication protocols, including I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-232/485, CAN, Ethernet, and USB.
* Hands\-on experience with standard electronics laboratory equipment for debugging and characterization (power supplies, electronic loads, multimeters, and oscilloscopes).
* Moderate proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems microcontroller programming.
* Fundamental understanding of EMI/EMC mitigation techniques and the ability to incorporate that into designs.
* Comprehensive understanding of fiber optic system components and how to integrate them into designs.
* Ability to troubleshoot and repair fiberoptic systems (multi\-mode and single\-mode circular mil and SC).
* Ability to travel up to 10%.

**Additional desired experience and skills:**


* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and a highly methodical approach to root\-cause analysis and troubleshooting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document processes and explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical groups.
* Highly detail\-oriented with a steadfast commitment to delivering high\-quality, reliable, and safe hardware.
* Ability to work both independently as a self\-starter with end\-to\-end design, and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

  

Apply today to discover your place in our world!

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. ### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco seeks a **Simulation Systems and Test Engineer** for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3\.0 program in Orlando, FL. The CAF DMO 3\.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world\-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting\-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world.
You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M\&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.
The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.  

**In this role, you will:**
* Support military simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.
* Use industry\-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).
* Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.
* Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.
* Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.
* Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.
* Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.
* Produce well\-defined, concise, and directed test procedures and test cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Support program and team processes by using tools from the Atlassian Suite of products to include JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and X\-Ray.
* Participate in peer reviews, test bed maintenance and updates, and programming, testing, and debugging activities.
* Write and maintain scripts and support application (PowerShell, Cygwin, VBasic, etc.) programs, to enable efficiencies in test artifact creation and task execution.
* Help identify production and non\-production application issues, assist in developing solutions, and implement necessary changes.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**
* A bachelor’s degree in an applicable STEM curriculum (e.g., Data Analysis, System Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or similar.
* 8 years of engineering experience performing test, integration, SW development, or embedded systems engineering activities.
* Experience with military simulation integration test DIS IEEE1278\.1 or HLA IEEE 1516 protocols, or similar communications or data protocols (SIP, VOIP, JREAP, etc).
* The ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Experience supporting DoD customers and personnel in a technical capacity.
* Familiarity or experience with development, test and evaluation of military simulation training or operational systems.
* Must possess, or obtain within six months, a DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher (i.e. Security\+, CySA\+, CISSP)
* Up to 10% travel

  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**  

**Additional desired experience and skills:**
* An active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Familiarity with tactical Military training systems, products, and capabilities.
* Exposure to or experience in M\&S development, test, and integration for constructive simulation systems and models.
* Knowledge of or experience with the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).
* Possess or obtain within six months, a Linux OS certification (i.e., Linux\+, RHCSA etc.).
  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. Odyssey has an exciting opportunity for an Air Operations Command and Control (C2\) Test Engineer supporting the 96th Cyberspace Test Group (96 CTG), the Department of Defense’s premier organization for Developmental Test \& Evaluation (DT\&E). The 96 CTG conducts critical DT\&E efforts for C4ISR, Cyber, and Electronic Warfare systems, ensuring mission readiness across the enterprise. In this role, you will directly contribute to shaping the next generation of Air Operations Center (AOC) and broader C2 capabilities by applying advanced test engineering expertise to highly complex operational and technical challenges.

This is a full\-time position located at Eglin AFB, FL.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

  

This onsite, entry\-level role located in Atlanta, GA

 **Job Summary:**

  

The Advanced Airborne RF Sensors department within the Space and Airborne Systems Engineering and Test Capability (SE\&TC) Center seeks talented Systems Engineers. Our team located in Atlanta, Georgia integrates hardware and software, develops test plans and procedures, debugs and evaluates system functions and interfaces, and verifies system requirements in support of final sell\-off to the customer. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab and in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. Every day is a different set of challenges to overcome. You'll be expected to collaborate across disciplines and partner to implement solutions. In this role, you'll get to know a little bit about every aspect of the system and have a direct hand in making it all work together supporting teams of engineers engaged in integration and test efforts.

  

You will support Electronic Warfare product development, engineering testing, integration and flight\-testing, production, system deployment, and post deployment support across the product lifecycle. Through Digital Transformation (DTx) you will perform these functions using a variety of methods and enabling technologies, including Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Agile product development.

  

This position is an onsite role in Atlanta, Georgia and Test event support activity may require travel which is not expected to exceed 20%.

 **What You Will Do:**

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to developing innovative solutions to technical challenges in signal processing design. Your responsibilities will involve assisting in the creation or modification of electronic warfare signal processing and control algorithms, as well as supporting the development and execution of test plans, simulations, and lab tests to verify system capabilities. You will help evaluate the functional performance of RF systems, including signal processing subsystems and firmware/control algorithms.


Additionally, you will assist in integration, verification, and troubleshooting activities in lab and field environments, utilizing test equipment to support root cause analyses and corrective actions. You will participate in preparing performance evaluations using tools like MATLAB, maintaining engineering specifications and drawings, and compiling findings for reports and briefings. Working alongside Engineering Integrated Product Team Leads (IPTLs), you will collaborate on team initiatives, attend meetings, and support the implementation of process requirements. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience and grow your skills in the field of systems engineering.

 **What You Will Learn:**

  

After completion of comprehensive on\-the\-job training, the candidate will be a part of a team supporting systems engineering, integration, and test activities across the product development lifecycle.

 **Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Physics or Computer Science (STEM preferred).
* Experience with tools, such as Microsoft Office, MATLAB or Python, for data analysis and automation
* Experience with troubleshooting technical issues with electronics in an academic or internship setting, including the use of common commercial test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, etc.)

  

Experience may be obtained through on\-the\-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

 **Qualifications We Prefer:**

* RF system design, digital and analog signal processing, waveform and signal modulation characteristics and analysis, and/or algorithm implementation and testing.
* Experience with electrical schematics, interface control documentation, and communications protocols
* Experience integrating software and firmware onto electronic hardware systems
* Experience with reading and integrating software routines with hardware/electronics; C/C\+\+/C\# preferred

 **What We Offer:**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation eligible

 **Learn More \& Apply Now!**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About This Role**


We are seeking a **Validation Software Engineer** with technical expertise to set the strategy and standards for our test and validation engineering organization. This role combines advanced C\# software architecture, electrical test system design, and platform\-wide technical leadership.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain software applications used for hardware control, automated testing, data acquisition, and reporting, with a primary focus on C\# development.

* Manage validation projects by coordinating schedules, resources, risks, deliverables, and communication with stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**Flight Software Engineer**

### **About Intuitive Machines:**

### **Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting\-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world\-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on\-orbit operations, and safety.**

**About the Position:**


Intuitive Machines is seeking a Flight Software Engineer to support the Landsat 10 mission under the OMES III contract at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, MD. This position requires hybrid on\-site support and the ability to obtain and maintain a NASA badge.


The selected candidate will join a multidisciplinary flight software team responsible for the development, integration, test, verification, and sustainment of mission\-critical spacecraft flight software supporting one of NASA's flagship Earth observation missions.


The successful candidate will participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements development through flight software delivery, integration, system testing, launch support, and on\-orbit operations. This position offers the opportunity to work alongside NASA civil servants, flight software developers, systems engineers, software assurance organizations, and spacecraft hardware teams in the development of highly reliable spaceflight systems.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, integrate, and test embedded flight software for spacecraft avionics systems.
* Support all phases of the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture design, implementation, unit testing, integration, verification, validation, and maintenance.
* Develop software for real\-time spacecraft applications operating on embedded processors and flight\-qualified operating systems.
* Participate in software peer reviews, design reviews, and formal NASA lifecycle reviews.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers, systems engineers, mission operations personnel, and software assurance teams.
* Support software integration activities with spacecraft avionics and communications hardware.
* Develop and maintain software documentation, test procedures, verification reports, and technical memoranda.
* Investigate software anomalies and support troubleshooting efforts during integration and test activities.
* Support Independent Verification \& Validation (IV\&V), Software Quality Assurance (SQA), and mission assurance activities.
* Assist with flight software readiness assessments and mission operations support as required.

 **Required Qualifications \& Experience :**

**Education:**


Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

**Experience**

* 15\+ years of experience developing software for embedded or real\-time systems.
* Familiarity with NPR 7150\.2
* Experience supporting the complete software development lifecycle from requirements through acceptance testing.
* Experience developing software within structured engineering processes utilizing industry\-recognized standards.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting NASA, DoD, NOAA, or commercial spaceflight programs.
* Flight software development experience for spacecraft, instruments, or ground\-support systems.
* Familiarity with software acquisition and government flight projects.
* Experience using:
* IBM DOORS or equivalent requirements management tools
* TDMS or equivalent configuration/data management systems
* Git, SVN, or other software configuration management tools
* Experience leading small software development teams or technical task groups.
* Knowledge of spacecraft command and data handling systems.
* Experience supporting environmental testing, integration and test campaigns, or launch preparation activities.

**Preferred Competencies**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative NASA and contractor environment.
* Self\-motivated with strong attention to detail and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced mission environment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test, Humanoid Robotics
jobs.description:
Boston Dynamics seeks a highly technical **Software Engineer in Test** , to test the Atlas Humanoid Robot. In this critical, hands\-on role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of Atlas’s software systems, focusing heavily on metrics based system testing for reliability and performance.  



  

A key quality to be successful in this role is the exceptional ability to context\-switch and rapidly acquire technical understanding across diverse domains: from web interfaces and network protocols to robot behavior and ML model validation. If you thrive on learning fast, solving cross\-functional problems, and seeing your code directly impact a groundbreaking robot, this role is for you.  



  

Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe\-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.  



  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* **Test \& Automation Design:** Design, develop, and maintain the comprehensive manual and automated overall regression test suite, focusing on integration stability. You will focus heavily on validating our teleoperation systems and action sequencing applications.
* **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) Testing:** Perform automated testing with physical hardware in the loop, executing actual sequencing setups, physical interventions, and real\-time robotic test runs.
* **XR Applications Testing:** Drive the end\-to\-end quality of virtual environments by designing both automated and manual testing strategies for VR and Unity\-based applications used in robot simulation and operator teleoperation.
* **Release Contribution \& Reporting:** Contribute to generating detailed Test Execution Reports for major milestones and releases, clearly documenting coverage and communicating quality status to the manager and development teams.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify bottlenecks and gaps in the SQA process and testing coverage, driving continuous improvement in execution efficiency and reliability.

**Required Experience:**

  

* 3–4 years of experience in Software QA Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Development, with a history of shipping and supporting product releases.
* Hands\-on experience with **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) manual testing** , including physical test setup manipulation and live sequencing execution on robotics, automotive, or embedded systems.
* Strong proficiency in test automation with a solid base in Python, C\#, or a similar language. Direct experience automating **HTTP and WebSocket (WS) APIs** is required.
* Demonstrated experience testing **LLM / VLM systems** , including evaluating model responses via manual prompting, API layers, and setting up quality assessment metrics.
* Experience executing both automated and manual test strategies for **VR and Unity\-based applications** , simulation software, or interactive 3D environments.
* Expertise in designing comprehensive test plans and executing functional, integration, and regression testing with strong manual rigor.
* Expertise in Defect Lifecycle Management using defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira) for precise defect reporting, verification, and analysis.
Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and experience integrating and monitoring automated tests within continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).  
* 

  

**Nice to Have Experience:**

  

* Experience testing real\-time control systems or low\-latency teleoperation hardware/software.
* Familiarity with UI/UX and backend validation for complex workflow sequencing or orchestration applications.
* Operational familiarity with a Linux development environment (e.g., advanced bash/shell scripting).
Experience with Root Cause Analysis on complex, cross\-functional system failures.  
* 

  

*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*

  

*The salary range for this position will be clearly stated in the job posting as required by Massachusetts law. The base pay range for this position is between $88,,000 \- $110,000\. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting.*

  

**Boston Dynamics will never ask you to divulge your personal financial or account information as part of its recruiting process.**

**Principal Mechanical \& Robotics Engineering Consultant**

**About Infratek**

Infratek is a technology company developing advanced systems for inspecting and maintaining critical infrastructure, including bridges, roadways, and other structures as well as assistive robotics systems for on\-demand and accessible mobility.

We design, integrate, and manufacture autonomous robotic platforms, non\-destructive evaluation technologies, and supporting software systems.

**The Opportunity**

Infratek is seeking a highly experienced Mechanical and Robotics Engineering Consultant to serve as a senior technical advisor to our engineering team.

This is not an entry\-level or early\-career position. We are looking for a seasoned engineering professional with extensive, hands\-on industry experience developing complex robotic, electromechanical, or automated machinery. The ideal consultant has taken multiple systems from concept through detailed design, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, deployment, and field support.

You should be equally comfortable reviewing calculations and drawings, working directly with hardware, and mentoring engineers.

* Serve as a senior technical authority for robotic mechanical systems and subsystems.
* Lead and participate in mechanical design reviews, architecture reviews, failure investigations, and technical risk assessments.

* Review designs, calculations, simulations, engineering drawings, specifications, bills of materials, test plans, and manufacturing documentation.

* Support mechanism design, structural analysis, dynamics, vibration analysis, tolerance analysis, thermal considerations, materials selection, and failure analysis.

* Experience conducting hazard analyses, design risk assessments, FMEA, fault\-tree analysis, and formal engineering design reviews.
* Experience designing load\-bearing, lifting, positioning, or material\-handling mechanisms with appropriate safety factors and fail\-safe features.
* Experience developing verification and validation programs, including structural, proof\-load, fatigue, vibr

This **Sr.** **Electrical/Electronics Engineer** position will be on a dynamic team responsible for Command Control Communications Computers Cyber Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance (C5ISR) Afloat and Ashore based communications support, maintenance, and sustainment on various USCG platforms for our customer in the Charleston, South Carolina area. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our national security.

  



**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain your active Secret clearance. This position is also contingent upon an award of contract.**

  



Serco supports the Naval Information Warfare Center (NIWC) Atlantic, including support for the Command Control Communications Computers Cyber Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance (C5ISR) Afloat and Ashore based communications support, maintenance, and sustainment on USCG platforms.

  

**In this role, you will:**


* Provide electrical and electronics engineering support for the design, integration, testing, installation, and sustainment of electrical and electronic systems.
* Provide electrical engineering support for shipboard C5ISR systems including power distribution, grounding, bonding, cable routing, and equipment rack integration.
* Develop and review technical documentation including design drawings, schematics, system diagrams, test procedures, technical reports, and engineering change documentation.
* Support development and execution of Engineering Change / Time Compliance Technical Orders (EC/TCTOs), including site surveys and as‑is system baseline collection.
* Support system requirements analysis, trade studies, and technical evaluations to ensure electrical designs meet performance, safety, and reliability requirements.
* Perform analysis and troubleshooting of electrical and electronic systems to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
* Perform electrical load analysis and power impact assessments for new or upgraded systems installed aboard cutters and shore facilities.
* Support emerging communications and SATCOM systems (e.g., MUOS, KU‑Band, PLEO STARLINK/KYMETA, IRIDIUM) from an electrical integration perspective.
* Support system integration and test activities, including pre‑installation checkout (PICO), pre‑installation test and checkout (PITCO), and system operational verification testing (SOVT).
* Support system readiness assessments, technical assistance visits, and CASREP resolution efforts for afloat and ashore platforms.
* Contribute to Systems Engineering Lifecycle (SELC) documentation and technical artifacts in accordance with DHS and NIWC Atlantic guidance.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards, specifications, and regulations (e.g., MIL‑STDs, NAVSEA requirements, IEEE standards, and safety codes).
* Provide installation planning support, including material staging, integration kit preparation, and coordination with shipyards and installation teams.
* Provide technical support during Government reviews, inspections, audits, and acceptance activities.
* Support configuration management and verification that electrical changes are properly evaluated, approved, documented, and implemented.
* Assist with risk identification, mitigation planning, and continuous improvement initiatives related to electrical system performance and reliability.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**  

* Bachelor's level degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience.
* An Active DoD Secret clearance is required to be considered.
* Hands‑on experience with electrical/electronics design, analysis, testing, integration, or troubleshooting.
* Experience developing and reviewing technical documentation for Government customers.
* Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and technical writing skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Government stakeholders, engineers, technicians, and cross‑functional contractor teams.
* Travel up to 10% may be required.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Network \& Controls Engineer designs, configures, integrates, and supports the secure communication paths that connect Nextracker’s field\-deployed tracker controllers, data hubs, SCADA systems, and customer networks to the Nextpower cloud environment.


This is an early\-career engineering role for a hands\-on problem solver who can work across network engineering, OT/SCADA connectivity, customer onboarding, systems integration, and process development. The role will support new project deployments and the operating fleet, working with Network Engineering, Controls and Software Engineering, Technical Services, Remote Monitoring, Field Services, Project teams, and customer IT/OT organizations.


The position is intended to build on the responsibilities of the Network Engineering Intern and expand them into full\-time ownership of defined network, SCADA, integration, and operational improvement workstreams.  



**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Network engineering and site connectivity**

* Design and review site connectivity solutions for new and existing solar projects, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, cellular gateways, leased\-line connections, and related network services.
* Review customer IT/OT standards, network diagrams, IP plans, routing requirements, segmentation requirements, and firewall policies.
* Prepare clear connectivity packages for internal and customer review, including IP addressing, subnetting, required ports and protocols, routing, firewall rules, remote\-access requirements, and validation steps.
* Configure and test network equipment using approved templates, standards, and change\-management procedures.
* Establish and maintain reliable communication between field devices, customer networks, and Nextpower data centers.

### **Data hub and field\-network deployment**

* Configure, stage, validate, and support data hubs and related field\-network equipment before shipment or deployment.
* Apply project\- and customer\-specific configuration, including IP addressing, routing, VLANs, firewall rules, DNS, NTP, VPN parameters, and secure remote\-access settings as applicable.
* Perform software and firmware upgrades under established procedures, validate successful deployment, and document all changes.
* Support site installation and commissioning activities remotely and, when required, at customer or project locations.
* Verify that field equipment is accessible, secure, correctly configured, and ready to deliver required operational data.

### **OPC, SCADA, and industrial\-protocol integration**

* Support the integration and reliable transport of SCADA and industrial protocols between tracker controllers, data hubs, customer SCADA systems, historians, and control centers.
* Configure and troubleshoot OPC/SCADA data paths, including OPC UA and related gateway or interface components when applicable.
* Support integrations using protocols such as Modbus TCP, DNP3, IEC 61850, or other customer\-required interfaces.
* Validate data\-point availability, naming, quality, timestamps, update rates, scaling, alarms, and control paths after installation or configuration changes.
* Assist with SCADA point lists, interface requirements, network\-port matrices, test scripts, commissioning checklists, and integration closeout documentation.
* Work with Controls, Software, Product, and Technical Services teams to distinguish network, protocol, device, application, and data\-quality issues.
* Help define repeatable architecture patterns for connecting Nextracker equipment to customer SCADA and historian environments.

### **Customer onboarding and technical support**

* Work with customers, EPCs, SCADA providers, project teams, and senior engineers to establish and verify connectivity from project sites to the Nextpower environment.
* Lead defined portions of customer connectivity calls, technical reviews, remote troubleshooting sessions, and commissioning activities.
* Explain network requirements, required customer actions, validation tests, and open issues in a clear, professional, service\-oriented manner.
* Troubleshoot TCP/IP networks, VPN tunnels, firewalls, routing, switching, DNS, NAT, packet loss, latency, port access, and device communication.
* Gather logs and evidence, run diagnostic commands and tests, document findings, and maintain clear ticket updates through resolution.
* Communicate impact, status, risks, ownership, next steps, and expected timing to internal stakeholders and customers.

### **Cybersecurity, access control, and change management**

* Apply secure\-by\-default practices to network and OT connectivity, including least\-privilege access, restricted ports, network segmentation, approved remote\-access methods, jump hosts, MFA where applicable, and secure credential handling.
* Support cybersecurity upgrade programs across the installed fleet and help identify risks or configuration gaps.
* Follow approved change\-management practices, including documented scope, approvals, maintenance windows, implementation steps, validation, back\-out plans, and closeout records.
* Escalate suspected security events, vulnerabilities, or material operational risks through defined procedures.
* Contribute to alignment with company cybersecurity requirements and applicable power\-industry practices, including NERC CIP or comparable frameworks where applicable.

### **Systems integration and process development**

* Translate recurring technical work into standard operating procedures, configuration templates, checklists, test plans, runbooks, and knowledge\-base content.
* Identify repeatable opportunities to improve onboarding, configuration, monitoring, testing, ticket triage, and fleet support.
* Help develop lightweight scripts, tools, dashboards, or automation to reduce manual work and improve configuration quality.

Reality Labs (RL) focuses on delivering Meta's vision through Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and Wearable AI Devices. The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of our AI devices require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. Our chips will unlock personalized on\-device AI capabilities and blend virtual, physical worlds on wearable devices. You will be part of our efforts to architect, design and implement a clean slate compiler for this activity and will be part of a team that includes compiler, machine learning algorithms and software, firmware and ASIC experts. * Analyze and improve the efficiency, scalability, and stability of compiler toolchains, ensuring they can be extended to new hardware targets
